title: Justice & Injustice
subtitle: The Playground Promise
keyMessage: Share, take turns, and include others.

scenes.heading: A fair day at the playground
scenes.narration: Hello! We are Ruhi, Aima, Nuh, and Fathima. Today we will explore what is fair and unfair.

scenes.heading: Eight sweets to share
scenes.narration: Here are eight sweets for four friends. How can we share them fairly?

scenes.heading: Everyone gets two sweets
scenes.narration: They share the sweets. Each friend gets two. Everyone has a fair share.

scenes.heading: What if one person keeps all?
scenes.narration: But what if one person keeps everything and nobody else gets a turn? That is unfair.

scenes.heading: Making it fair again
scenes.narration: Nuh notices, says sorry, and shares. We can make unfair things fairer.

scenes.heading: Taking turns on the slide
scenes.narration: Ruhi goes first. Then Aima, Nuh, and Fathima each get a turn. Taking turns is fair!

scenes.heading: Help, care, and include friends
scenes.narration: We can also help, care, show respect, and invite our friends to play.

scenes.heading: Fair means everyone has a chance
scenes.narration: Fair means giving everyone a chance. Unfair means someone is left out or treated badly.

scenes.heading: Your turn to think!
scenes.narration: A friend has been waiting to play. What could you do to make it fair?

title: Wealth & Poverty
subtitle: What Makes a Good Friend?
keyMessage: Having more money does not make someone better. Kindness matters most.

scenes.heading: At the school fair
scenes.narration: At the school fair, Ruhi, Aima, Nuh, and Fathima are learning that kindness matters more than money.

scenes.heading: Different amounts of tokens
scenes.narration: In this pretend game, Nuh has more tokens and Aima has fewer. Families in the world can also have different amounts of money.

scenes.heading: Everyone matters equally
scenes.narration: Having more money does not make someone a better person. Everyone matters.

scenes.heading: Kindness in action
scenes.narration: Fathima helps Ruhi with kindness. Being helpful matters, not how many coins we own.

scenes.heading: Respect and equal care
scenes.narration: Fathima invites Aima to play a free game with everyone. We show the same care and respect, whether someone has more money or less.

scenes.heading: Choose kind behavior
scenes.narration: Teasing is unkind. Welcoming someone and sharing is kind.

scenes.heading: Kindness is for everyone
scenes.narration: You do not have to be rich to be a good person. Kindness is something we can all show.

scenes.heading: Your turn to think!
scenes.narration: What is one kind thing you could do for a friend sitting alone?

title: Equality of Opportunity
subtitle: Everyone Gets a Chance
keyMessage: Friends can like different things, and everyone deserves a fair chance to join.

scenes.heading: A picnic in the garden
scenes.narration: Ruhi, Aima, Nuh, and Fathima have different favorite foods and games. That is okay!

scenes.heading: Four different favorites
scenes.narration: Ruhi likes cucumbers. Aima likes mangoes. Nuh likes apples. Fathima likes bananas.

scenes.heading: Different and still good friends
scenes.narration: Friends do not have to like the same things. We can still be good friends.

scenes.heading: Different games to enjoy
scenes.narration: One friend loves ball games. Another loves drawing. Everyone can enjoy different activities.

scenes.heading: Include a waiting friend
scenes.narration: Aima has not had a turn yet. Fathima notices and asks the others to include her.

scenes.heading: Playing together fairly
scenes.narration: Everyone should have a fair chance to take part, even when we are different.

scenes.heading: Fair chance for everyone
scenes.narration: Different choices are welcome. Fair opportunity means everyone gets a chance.

scenes.heading: Your turn to think!
scenes.narration: What could the friends do so Fathima gets a chance to join?

title: Challenging Injustice
subtitle: Let's Make It Right
keyMessage: Admit mistakes, apologize, tell the truth, and help repair the harm.

scenes.heading: Art time with friends
scenes.narration: It is art time! Ruhi, Aima, Nuh, and Fathima are building together.

scenes.heading: An accidental bump
scenes.narration: Oh no! Fathima accidentally bumps Nuh's block tower. The blocks fall down.

scenes.heading: Noticing our feelings
scenes.narration: Fathima feels worried. Nuh feels sad. Mistakes can hurt people's feelings.

scenes.heading: Telling the truth
scenes.narration: Fathima tells the truth: I bumped your blocks by mistake.

scenes.heading: Saying sorry sincerely
scenes.narration: I am sorry, says Fathima. It is important to say sorry when we hurt someone.

scenes.heading: Helping to rebuild
scenes.narration: Fathima helps pick up the blocks. Her friends join in. Together, they make things better.

scenes.heading: Asking a teacher for help
scenes.narration: If we do something wrong, telling the truth and asking a teacher for help can be the right choice.

scenes.heading: Ask politely, do not grab
scenes.narration: We should not grab things from someone. We can ask and wait politely.

scenes.heading: Admit, apologize, and repair
scenes.narration: When we make a mistake, we can admit it, say sorry, and try to make things right.

scenes.heading: Your turn to think!
scenes.narration: You accidentally knock over your friend's pencils. What would you say?
